tagline: Australia's festival city — ringed by wine valleys, famous for the Fringe, and home to the country's best market.
overview: Adelaide is the quiet overachiever: the '20-minute city' was designed in a ring of parklands, its Festival and Fringe make it one of the world's great arts cities each March, and three world-class wine regions start within an hour's drive.

The Central Market is the city's soul — 70+ stalls of cheese, smallgoods and produce under one 1869 roof, feeding a food culture that punches far above Adelaide's size. The oval's roofline — the restored Adelaide Oval with its climb — crowns the park edge.
Speed's 2024 tour streamed from Adelaide. The Barossa and McLaren Vale valleys put shiraz tastings within a lunch hour, and Kangaroo Island — Australia's Galápagos — is the weekend escape.
